name: Jidbas
title: Son of Nahor
summary: Jidbas was one of the sons of Nahor, Abraham's brother, and his wife Milcah. He is mentioned in the genealogy in Genesis 22 as part of Abraham's extended family. Although Jidbas does not play a prominent role in the biblical narrative, he is part of the patriarchal lineage that connects Abraham's family with the surrounding peoples.

keyEvents.title: The News about the Sons of Nahor
keyEvents.description: After Abraham had passed the test with Isaac on Mount Moriah, he was told that his brother Nahor had eight sons with his wife Milcah, including Jidbas.

keyEvents.title: The Lineage of Nahor
keyEvents.description: Jidbas is mentioned as part of Nahor's lineage, which connected Abraham's family to other ethnic groups in Mesopotamia.

keyEvents.title: The Connection to Abraham's Trial
keyEvents.description: The report about the sons of Nahor, including Jidbas, came right after Abraham's willingness to sacrifice Isaac, marking a transition in the narrative toward finding a wife for Isaac.

keyEvents.title: The Context of Rebekah's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Jidbas' brother Bethuel became the father of Rebekah, who later became Isaac's wife. Jidbas was thus Rebekah's uncle and part of the family to whom Abraham sent his servant.
